findings.message: GSAP tween on "#end-kick" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: letterSpacing. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: do not animate letterSpacing (they reflow text and snap glyph positions): for letterSpacing, split the text into per-character elements and animate each glyph's x (the spread), since uniform scale is NOT equivalent, or hold the final value statically. Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: Track 3 has 6 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.
